title: Charged Hawking Mass on CMC Collars with Charged Matter
summary: We study strictly stable minimal horizons in three-dimensional time-symmetric charged initial data sets with cosmological constant, allowing charged matter. Along the constant-mean-curvature foliation issuing from the horizon through leaves with positive Jacobi operator, we prove exact first-variation identities for the charged Hawking mass.
